resources.string: Explore a verse: compare related Bible passages, look up word meanings and record your own thoughts.
Other verses related to the selected verse. Tap “Open” to read the full passage.
Meanings of the original Greek and Hebrew words. Available in translations with Strong markup; tap a word number, such as G25.
Personal notes on a verse. Open the ⋮ menu beside a verse in the reader and choose “%1$s”.
